# Real Online Ruler

> A free online tool that turns any screen into an accurate ruler at true physical size. No download, no sign-up, no account. Works on phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops.

Real Online Ruler (https://realonlineruler.online/) displays an on-screen ruler calibrated to real-world units. Users calibrate with a credit card, a known screen size, or automatic device detection, then measure objects directly against the screen in centimeters, millimeters, inches, or pixels.

## Main pages

- [Online ruler](https://realonlineruler.online/): the interactive measuring tool with unit switching (cm, mm, inches, pixels), themes, and precision controls.
- [How to calibrate](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-calibrate/): step-by-step calibration using a credit card, manual PPI entry, or device presets.
- [Guide](https://realonlineruler.online/guide/): how to read the ruler and measure accurately on screen.
- [Centimeter ruler](https://realonlineruler.online/cm/), [Inch ruler](https://realonlineruler.online/inches/), [Millimeter ruler](https://realonlineruler.online/mm/), [Pixel ruler](https://realonlineruler.online/pixels/): unit-focused ruler pages.

## Articles

Practical measurement how-tos (English; each with its own publish date).
Full index: [How-to guides](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to/)

- [How to Measure Your Ring Size at Home](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-measure-ring-size/) (2026-10-04): paper-strip and existing-ring methods, measure in millimeters on the on-screen ruler, US/UK/EU size chart.
- [How to Measure Your Pupillary Distance (PD) at Home](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-measure-pupillary-distance/) (2026-10-07): mirror and helper methods, single vs dual PD explained, on-screen mm ruler instead of a physical one.
- [What Does an Inch Look Like? Actual Size on Your Screen](https://realonlineruler.online/what-does-an-inch-look-like/) (2026-10-10): 1/2/3 inches and 5/10 cm drawn at true physical size on the visitor's screen using their calibration, plus everyday objects (credit card, AA battery, US quarter) at actual size.

- [How to Measure Your Foot Size at Home](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-measure-foot-size/) (2026-10-05): paper-trace and direct-wall methods with the on-screen cm ruler, evening-measure and wiggle-room tips, Brannock-verified US shoe-size chart.
- [How to Measure Your Wrist Size](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-measure-wrist-size/) (2026-10-06): measure wrist at home with a paper strip and the on-screen mm ruler; includes bracelet ease chart (snug/comfort/loose) and watch-fit guidance.
- [How Big Is 4 Inches? See It at Actual Size](https://realonlineruler.online/how-big-is-4-inches/) (2026-10-07): see exactly how big 4 inches is at true size on screen, with 1–3 inch bars and everyday objects (AA batteries, credit card) for scale.
- [How to Measure Your Head Size](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-measure-head-size/) (2026-10-08): measure your head circumference at home with tape or string and the on-screen cm ruler, with a hat-size chart and helmet-fit guidance.
- [How to Identify a Screw or Bolt Size](https://realonlineruler.online/how-to-identify-screw-size/) (2026-10-09): identify any screw or bolt at home — measure diameter and length with the on-screen mm ruler, read metric labels like M6 × 30, and match against known screws.

## Advanced features

- Drag-to-measure with live distance and angle readout
- Protractor overlay for angle measurement
- Magnifier loupe for precise alignment
- Floating, rotatable on-screen ruler
- Measurement log with CSV/TXT export
- Grid overlay

## Legal and contact

- [About](https://realonlineruler.online/about/): built by Firoz Khan (FK Digital Media).
- [Privacy Policy](https://realonlineruler.online/privacy-policy/): no accounts; measurements and preferences stay in the browser (localStorage); Google Analytics is used for basic usage statistics.
- [Terms of Service](https://realonlineruler.online/terms-of-service/): free as-is tool; on-screen measurements are approximate and not for medical, engineering, safety, or legal decisions.
- [Contact](https://realonlineruler.online/contact/): support@realonlineruler.online and public profiles.

## Localization

Every page is available in six languages under locale prefixes: /es/ (Spanish), /fr/ (French), /pt/ (Brazilian Portuguese), /zh/ (Simplified Chinese), /id/ (Indonesian). English is the default at the root path.

## Technical notes for crawlers and LLMs

- Static site; all content is server-rendered HTML.
- Canonical URLs use https://realonlineruler.online/.
- Sitemap: https://realonlineruler.online/sitemap-index.xml
